summary: Bounded keyboard memory, glass lifecycle, private voice buffers and prediction/swipe efficiency.

changes.title: Bounded keyboard memory
changes.detail: Keep four recent alphabet layouts warm and bound soft layout entries; invalidate both tiers on geometry, locale or theme changes.

changes.title: Glass lifecycle and redraws
changes.detail: Restore GPU blur on same-size reattachment, detach source observers, and coalesce repeated frame requests without changing glass styling.

changes.title: Private voice buffer reuse
changes.detail: Reuse bounded zeroized capture-frame buffers without changing speech order, batch duration, model or cancellation policy.

changes.title: Prediction and swipe efficiency
changes.detail: Reject stale cache writes and Emoji results, skip disabled reranking work, reuse swipe geometry and support denser touch samples; preserve native ranking.
